description: The host AIOS's hooks: at every session start, the check hook says whether the AIOS folder holds the whole template and whether every line of the master map names a top-level design that exists; at every prompt, the mode guard adds one instruction to the turn — name the request's mode, open its start, write the mode line; before every agent or workflow dispatch, the dispatch guard refuses one that orders a worktree on a new branch; before every write of a DESIGN.md, a board, an architecture map, a top-level design or another file a skill makes, the skill guard refuses it while the agent writing it has not opened the skill that makes that kind of file; at the first stop of a turn that changed a file, the session's or a helper agent's, the fixpoint guard holds the turn once for a re-read that finds nothing wrong.
